bar: Why: sv-5b/sv-5c found 0 token differences in 200 runs of 256 tokens, but the logits do move (up to 9e-5) and only 2 of 51,200 steps had a top-1 minus top-2 margin that small, so those runs could not measure a rate of a few per million. Setup: clean SmolLM2-135M checkpoint of sv-5, fp32, pinned sv-5 stack. 8,000 text windows from UltraChat conversations taken from the end of the sv-5 shuffled order (no overlap with the sv-5 prompts), each cut to a length drawn with a fixed seed from 160..256 tokens (about 1.66 million positions). One full forward pass per window; at every position record the argmax next token and the top-1 minus top-2 logit margin. Reference R = box1 (AVX2), one window at a time, one thread, all windows. X = other CPU class, one window at a time, one thread: box2 for windows 0-3,999, box3 for windows 4,000-7,999. B = box1, batches of 8 consecutive windows, left padding with attention mask, one thread, all windows. (x) cross-class MET only if X differs from R in the argmax token at 3 or more positions AND at a rate of at least 1 per 1,000,000 compared positions. (b) batching, own verdict, same rule for B against R. If a part is not met, the report states the count, the positions compared and the 95 percent upper bound on the rate. Reported without a bar: T = box1 two threads (windows 0-1,999), S = penguin same CPU class (windows 0-1,999), size of the margin shifts, the reference margin at each differing position, and the implied share of 256-token responses whose greedy output would differ. Prediction written before the run, from the sv-5c margins: 2 to 4 differing positions per million. Limits stated in advance: positions are teacher-forced on natural text, not greedy trajectories; a difference means a greedy decoder would emit a different next token at that context. Exact replay under the CIS-2 runtime is identical across these hosts by construction and by sv-5 measurement; it is not re-measured here.
title: Per-token divergence rate of a stock PyTorch rerun across CPU classes and under batching (1.6M positions, SmolLM2-135M)
